findings.title: The documented sqlExpressions feature flag is now a no-op
findings.body: `enableSqlExpressions` returns false regardless of the global `sqlExpressions` flag value, so deployments that have configured the documented flag cannot enable the feature and receive "sqlExpressions is not implemented" instead. The PR leaves the feature-toggle documentation unchanged despite changing that configuration contract. Update the documentation to state that SQL expressions are disabled/removed (and that the flag has no effect), or remove the stale flag documentation.

findings.title: The security disablement has no automated regression coverage
findings.body: No test is added to verify that a `QueryTypeSQL` query is rejected even when `FlagSqlExpressions` is globally enabled. The legacy `UnmarshalSQLCommand` path also bypasses this reader and is only disabled indirectly because the replacement DB returns "not implemented". Add regression tests for both entry points which assert that SQL is rejected before it can be parsed or executed; otherwise a future attempt to restore the DB implementation or simplify the feature check can reintroduce the RCE/LFI path without test detection.
